scripts.build: bun run validate:content && astro check && astro build
scripts.build:cms:local: bun run validate:content && TINA_CMS=true tinacms build --local --skip-cloud-checks -c "astro check && astro build"
scripts.build:cloudflare: bun run validate:content && TINA_CMS=true tinacms build --content=local -c "astro check && astro build"
scripts.test:strict: node --test tests/content-rules.test.mjs tests/hero-media-range.test.mjs tests/llms-txt.test.mjs tests/mobile-hero-video.test.mjs tests/navigation-scroll.test.mjs tests/site-structured-data.test.mjs tests/tina-integration.test.mjs tests/upcoming-events.test.mjs tests/workers-build-environment.test.mjs
scripts.validate:content: bun run validate:schema && bun run validate:contracts && bun run verify:hero-video && bun run test:strict
